text_en: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?
text_cn: 我不是自由的吗？我不是宗徒吗？我不是见过我们的主耶稣吗？你们不是我在主内所建的工程吗？

text_en: If I am not an apostle to others, at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
text_cn: 纵然我为别人不是宗徒，为你们我总是，因为你们在主内正是我任宗徒职分的印证。

text_en: This is my defense to those who would examine me.
text_cn: 这也就是我对那些质问我的人的答辩。

text_en: Do we not have the right to our food and drink?
text_cn: 难道我们没有取得饮食的权利吗？

text_en: Do we not have the right to be accompanied by a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the brothers of the Lord and Cephas?
text_cn: 难道我们没有权利携带一位为姊妹的妇人，如其他的宗徒及主的弟兄并刻法一样吗？

text_en: Or is it only Barnabas and I who have no right to refrain from working for a living?
text_cn: 或者，唯有我和巴尔纳伯没有不劳作的权利吗？

text_en: Who at any time pays the expenses for doing military service? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat any of its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not get any of its milk?
text_cn: 谁当兵而自备粮饷呢？谁种植葡萄园而不吃它的出产呢？或者，谁牧放羊群而不吃羊群的奶呢？

text_en: Do I say this on human authority? Does not the law also say the same?
text_cn: 我说这话，难道是按人之常情？法律不是也这样说吗？

text_en: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain. ” Is it for oxen that God is concerned?
text_cn: 原来梅瑟法律上记载说：“牛在打场的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。”难道天主所关心的是牛吗？

text_en: Or does he not speak entirely for our sake? It was indeed written for our sake, for whoever plows should plow in hope and whoever threshes should thresh in hope of a share in the crop.
text_cn: 岂不是完全为我们说的吗？的确是为我们记载的，因为犁地的当怀着希望去犁，打场的也当怀着有份的希望去打场。

text_en: If we have sown spiritual good among you, is it too much if we reap your material benefits?
text_cn: 若是我们给你们散播神圣的恩惠，而收割你们那属物质的东西，还算什么大事？

text_en: If others share this rightful claim on you, do not we still more? Nevertheless, we have not made use of this right, but we endure anything rather than put an obstacle in the way of the gospel of Christ.
text_cn: 如果别人在你们身上尚且分享权利，我们岂不更该吗？可是我们没有用过这权利，反倒忍受了一切，免得基督的福音受到妨碍。

text_en: Do you not know that those who are employed in the temple service get their food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share in what is sacrificed on the altar?
text_cn: 你们岂不知道为圣事服务的，就靠圣殿生活；供职于祭坛的，就分享祭坛上的物品吗？

text_en: In the same way, the Lord commanded that those who proclaim the gospel should get their living by the gospel.
text_cn: 主也这样规定了，传福音的人，应靠福音而生活。

text_en: But I have made no use of any of these rights, nor am I writing this so that they may be applied in my case. Indeed, I would rather die than that—no one will deprive me of my ground for boasting!
text_cn: 可是，这些权利我一样也没有用过；我写这话，并非要人这样对待我，因为我宁愿死，也不愿让人使我这夸耀落了空。

text_en: If I proclaim the gospel, this gives me no ground for boasting, for an obligation is laid on me, and woe to me if I do not proclaim the gospel!
text_cn: 我若传福音，原没有什么可夸耀的，因为这是我不得已的事；我若不传福音，我就有祸了。

text_en: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward; but if not of my own will, I am entrusted with a commission.
text_cn: 假使我自愿作这事，便有报酬；若不自愿，可是责任已委托给我。

text_en: What then is my reward? Just this: that in my proclamation I may make the gospel free of charge, so as not to make full use of my rights in the gospel.
text_cn: 这样看来，我的报酬是什么呢？就是传布福音时白白地去传，不享用我在传福音上所有的权利。

text_en: For though I am free with respect to all, I have made myself a slave to all, so that I might win more of them.
text_cn: 我原是自由的，不属于任何人；但我却使自己成了众人的奴仆，为赢得更多的人。

text_en: To the Jews I became as a Jew, in order to win Jews. To those under the law I became as one under the law (though I myself am not under the law) so that I might win those under the law.
text_cn: 对犹太人，我就成为犹太人，为赢得犹太人；对于在法律下的人，我虽不在法律下，仍成为在法律下的人，为赢得那在法律下的人；

text_en: To those outside the law I became as one outside the law (though I am not free from God’s law but am under Christ’s law) so that I might win those outside the law.
text_cn: 对那些法律以外的人，我就成为法律以外的人，为赢得那些法律以外的人；其实，我并不在天主的法律以外，而是在基督的法律之下。

text_en: To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, that I might by all means save some.
text_cn: 对软弱的人，我就成为软弱的，为赢得那软弱的人；对一切人，我就成为一切，为的是总要救些人。

text_en: I do it all for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings.
text_cn: 我所行的一切，都是为了福音，为能与人共沾福音的恩许。

text_en: Do you not know that in a race the runners all compete, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may win it.
text_cn: 你们岂不知道在运动场上赛跑的，固然都跑，但只有一个得奖赏吗？你们也应该这样跑，好能得到奖赏。

text_en: Athletes exercise self-control in all things; they do it to receive a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable one.
text_cn: 凡比武竞赛的，在一切事上都有节制；他们只是为得到可朽坏的花冠，而我们却是为得到不朽坏的花冠。

text_en: So I do not run aimlessly, nor do I box as though beating the air;
text_cn: 所以我总是这样跑，不是如同无定向的；我这样打拳，不是如同打空气的；

text_en: but I punish my body and enslave it, so that after proclaiming to others I myself should not be disqualified.
text_cn: 我痛击我身，使它为奴，免得我给别人报捷，自己反而落选。
